name: trueAirspeed
description: True airspeed, ft/sec

name: angleOfAttack
description: Instantaneous true angle-of-attack, in degrees

name: angleOfSideslip
description: Instantaneous true angle-of-sideslip, in degrees

name: bodyAngularRate_Roll
description: Body roll rate, rad/sec

name: bodyAngularRate_Pitch
description: Body pitch rate, rad/sec

name: bodyAngularRate_Yaw
description: Body yaw rate, rad/sec

name: elevatorDeflection
description: Elevator deflection angle, in degrees (+TED)

name: aileronDeflection
description: Aileron deflection angle, in degrees (+LWD)

name: rudderDeflection
description: Rudder deflection angle, in degrees (+TEL)

name: rtd
description: Conversion constant from radians to degrees

name: referenceWingChord
description: Length of aerodynamic chord, ft

name: referenceWingSpan
description: Length of aerodynamic span, ft

name: referenceWingArea
description: Reference area of aerodynamic model, ft2

name: del
description: Normalized elevator deflection (note range is beyond breakpoint range)

name: dail
description: Normalized aileron deflection.

name: drdr
description: Normalized rudder deflection.

name: CX0
description: Basic coefficient of force in the X-body direction (+FWD). Function table based on angle of attack and elevator deflection.

name: CY0
description: Basic coefficient of force in the Y-body direction (+right). Function of sideslip angle, aileron and rudder deflection.

name: CZ0
description: Basic coefficient of force in the Z-body direction (+DWN). Function table based on angle of attack and elevator deflection.

name: CZ1
description: Coefficient of force in the Z-body direction, modified from basic CZ0 to include effects of sideslip and elevator deflection.

name: tvt
description: Twice velocity.

name: b2v
description: Wing span over 2 times velocity. Used for coefficient normalization.

name: cq2v
description: Chord times pitch rate over 2 times velocity. Used to normalize aero coefficients.

name: absbeta
description: Absolute value of angle-of-sideslip, deg.

name: absCl0
description: Absolute value of rolling moment coefficient

name: absCn0
description: Absolute value of yawing moment coefficient

name: Cl0
description: Basic coefficient of moment around the X-body direction (roll) (+RWD)

name: Cm0
description: Basic coefficient of moment around the Y-body direction (pitch) (+ANU)

name: Cn0
description: Basic coefficient of moment around the Z-body direction (yaw) (+RWD)

name: CXq
description: Damping derivative: axial force increment per radian/sec of pitch rate

name: CYr
description: Damping derivative: lateral force increment per radian/sec of yaw rate

name: CYp
description: Damping derivative: lateral force increment per radian/sec of roll rate

name: CZq
description: Damping derivative: vertical force increment per radian/sec of pitch rate

name: Clr
description: Damping derivative: rolling moment increment per radian/sec of yaw rate

name: Clp
description: Damping derivative: rolling moment increment per radian/sec of roll rate

name: Cmq
description: Damping derivative: pitching moment increment per radian/sec of pitch rate

name: Cnr
description: Damping derivative: yawing moment increment per radian/sec of yaw rate

name: Cnp
description: Damping derivative: yawing moment increment per radian/sec of roll rate

name: ClDA
description: Control power derivative: rolling moment per deg of aileron deflection

name: ClDR
description: Control power derivative: rolling moment per deg of rudder deflection

name: CnDA
description: Control power derivative: yawing moment per deg of aileron deflection

name: CnDR
description: Control power derivative: yawing moment per deg of rudder deflection

name: Cl1
description: Initial value of rolling moment, less damping terms

name: Cn
description: Initial value of rolling moment coefficient without damping terms

name: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_X
description: Total coefficient of force along the body X-axis acting at the moment reference center

name: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_Y
description: Total coefficient of force along the body Y-axis acting at the moment reference center

name: aeroBodyForceCoefficient_Z
description: Total coefficient of force along the body Z-axis acting at the moment reference center

name: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Roll
description: Total coefficient of moment around the moment reference center in the body X-axis (rolling moment)

name: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Pitch
description: Total coefficient of moment around the moment reference center in the body Y-axis (pitching moment)

name: aeroBodyMomentCoefficient_Yaw
description: Total coefficient of moment around the moment reference center in the body Z-axis (yawing moment)
